description: Translate a Word document (docx) into another language while keeping its layout (tables, headers/footers, images, styles stay; only the text changes). Required: document_id (a docx from documents) OR storage_path (a docx path of this tenant in entity-docs, e.g. a report_path), sprache ('it'|'fr'|'en'|'de'). Optional: glossar [{quelle, ziel}] for fixed technical terms, bezug {typ, id} (e.g. {typ:'deal', id:'1000'}). The server splits the document into paragraphs and hands the job to the tenant's 'Übersetzungs-Agent' (Claude in the runner); poll get_uebersetzung(auftrag_id) — when status is 'fertig', ziel_document_id is the translated docx (title gets the language). Same document + language again returns the existing job. If you ARE the Übersetzungs-Agent, call get_uebersetzungsauftrag next and translate yourself.

bezug.description: Record the translation belongs to, e.g. {typ:'deal', id:'1000'}

typ.description: Type of the related record (e.g. deal)

storage_path.description: Alternative to document_id: docx path of this tenant (entity-docs).

name: uebersetze_dokument
